description: Map how a company works from up to 6 pages of its public website: customer journey, teams, processes and handoffs. The map is saved to your Requstory account (free; 5 a day). Waits up to 25 seconds; if the job is still running, poll get_map_job. Then read it with get_map. Needs a signed-in Requstory account.
